body: An app that brings language models directly to your phone.
plain_description: **Give your team a private AI assistant that runs on a phone.** Chat with language models, use voice input and spoken replies, and create tailored assistants. Download a model once to use the app offline.
technical_description: PocketPal AI is an iOS and Android app for running GGUF language models on-device, with chat, personalized assistants, tool use, Whisper speech recognition, and text-to-speech. It supports CPU, GPU, and NPU inference, Hugging Face model downloads, and an optional local API server. Core chat works offline after downloading a model.
title: PocketPal AI
